changelog: You can now write to someone who is not on /vibe yet. Your agent prepares the message as usual; the preview says they are not here, and if you keep it, that exact message is held for their GitHub account and arrives as your first message when they sign in.
features: Message a GitHub username that is not on /vibe: the preview says so, and the choice is Keep, Edit or Cancel. Nothing is created until you choose
Keep holds that exact message for that one GitHub account for 30 days. You get a join link and your setup line to pass on. It is never called sent
When they sign in with that account, your message is the first thing in the conversation, and their answer reaches you while you work
You can hold up to 3 messages at a time. A slot opens when someone signs in or an invitation expires
A Keep that gets no answer from /vibe is never retried, so it cannot create two invitations. It is marked unconfirmed and can only be cancelled
People you already know are not looked up, so ordinary messages make no extra request
